info.title: Integrations Admin API
info.description: Merchant admin-style integration endpoints under /api/v1/integrations/admin (catalog management, inventory, orders, customers, shipping, payments, settings, and dashboard). Authenticate with X-Api-Key (sk_test_… / sk_live_…) or Bearer OAuth access token with write scopes as required.

StoreSlug.name: X-Store-Slug
StoreSlug.description: Store slug for tenant context (required for storefront/tenant routes unless Host resolves a store).

StoreId.name: X-Store-Id
StoreId.description: Store publicId (UUID) for tenant context. Prefer X-Store-Slug when possible.

paymentProvider.description: Billing payment provider. Defaults to paystack when available.
